regime: Overheat with an AI de-rating: firm growth and labor, sticky inflation (core PCE 3.1%, PPI 6.5%) and a Fed hiking into 2027, while the AI/semiconductor complex unwinds and the S&P 500 enters correction
summary: Since Nov 12 the macro regime is unchanged (overheat, Dec 9 hike priced ~97-100%, futures near 4.5% by mid-2027), but the market regime turned: SPY fell into correction (-11% from its record), QQQ closed 0.7 above its -20% line and SMH lost 24% in a month as AI payback doubts spread from Nvidia to memory, Broadcom and the Anthropic IPO. Defensive leadership is now the clear trend (staples +10pp, health care +7pp vs SPY over 1 month), oil fell to $84-90 on growth fears, and credit is softening (HY ETF at a 3-month low). The portfolio stays defensive: energy, quality health care, higher-for-longer financials and defensive consumer; LMT is removed after closing below its invalidation, and CME, MCK and XLP are added to the watch list.
drivers: Fed funds futures: Dec 9 hike fully priced, about 4.5% by mid-2027; Cook warns delay risks 'getting behind the curve'
10Y 4.91% after a -24bp haven rally in 5 days, still +78bp over 1 year; 10Y real yield 2.88% (98th pct)
AI de-rating: SMH -23.6% over 1 month, NVDA -13.7% on Nov 20; Nasdaq erased its 2026 gain
Defensive rotation: staples +10.2pp, real estate +9.6pp, utilities +9.3pp vs SPY over 1 month
Oil: WTI 83.8, Brent 90.1, -16% to -20% in a month despite Iran strikes being weighed; OPEC+ Nov 29
Credit: HY ETF 76.35 (3-month low), HY spread 3.52pp (86th pct)
risks: A violent AI/growth rebound from extreme fear leaves the defensive portfolio lagging
Credit deleveraging spreads to all sectors, including defensives and financials
A hot October PCE (Nov 25) or 50bp December hike re-rates high-P/E defensives (WMT 39.6x, KO/XLP)
An Iran deal or OPEC+ supply increase sends WTI below $80 and breaks the energy theme
Drug-pricing policy or CMS rules hit health care

themes.name: Energy supply squeeze
themes.why: Hormuz attacks continue and Trump is weighing new Iran strikes; a low-cost producer earns well even at $85-90 Brent, but the growth scare has pushed oil to 3-month lows.

themes.name: Quality health care
themes.why: Cycle-independent earnings and the leading defensive group (XLV +7.5pp vs SPY over 1 month, +26pp over 6 months); distributors avoid drug-pricing risk.

themes.name: Higher-for-longer financials
themes.why: A Fed hiking into 2027 lifts insurer float income; exchanges earn more from record volatility and rate hedging (VIX 36, MOVE 96).

themes.name: Defensive consumer compounder
themes.why: Consumer sentiment near record lows (UMich 51.5) pushes trade-down to discount retail; staples lead SPY by 10pp over 1 month.
